summary: Frontend-only verification of the seamless CSS transitions on the universal address-field landing (preview URL). All 10 requested flows behave as intended: empty landing shows 'Kodama Talk' + purpose with no reveal; typing 'alex' briefly shows CHECKING then resolves to CLAIMED with door-view (data-testid='door-view') unfolding beneath a stable field (bounding box x=632/width~195 remains unchanged across states) and the browser URL stays '/'; typing 'bri' resolves to AVAILABLE and shows claim-view; switching alex→studio dissolves the old and reveals the new without URL change; 'admin' shows reserved-state with no claim-view; pasting 'https://talk.kodama.page/alex' normalizes and reveals door-view with URL still '/'; direct link /alex renders committed door-view with address-bar at top; direct link /my-new-place renders address-unavailable + claim-this-btn; owner enters Shelf by typing alex → clicking this-is-me → entering 'secret' in unlock-password → unlock-submit, revealing shelf-main and shelf-rail; lock-shelf returns to door-view for /alex with no errors. No console errors or page errors observed across any transition.
critical_code_review_comments: SceneFade correctly gates on prefers-reduced-motion and settles container height to prevent layout jump — implementation is clean and CSS-only.

TalkSurface reveals via <SceneFade sceneKey=`${status}:${slug}`> so the old scene dissolves before the new one unfolds when the address changes (verified with alex→studio switch). Field stays stable across scenes because it is rendered above the SceneFade region.

Reduced-motion CSS overrides in talk.css (lines 575-598) cover .talk-scene, .talk-scene--in/out, .talk-enter and disable .talk-scene-wrap height transition — matches the requirement for immediate non-jarring state changes.
test_credentials: Owner password for /alex: 'secret' (any 4+ chars accepted by mock).
seed_data_creation: None. Cleared localStorage/sessionStorage between owner-shelf test and other flows so 'alex' resolves as CLAIMED (not 'yours').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview: https://door-shelf.preview.emergentagent.com. Debounce is ~400ms — wait for [data-testid=availability-status][data-status] to transition rather than fixed sleeps. When clicking this-is-me on the landing reveal, use a normal click() (not force=True) — force clicks can fire before the button is layout-scrolled into view since the reveal expands the surface; a plain click() auto-waits + scrolls. All testids from iteration_16 remain valid. Field x/width was verified stable (632/~195) across empty→alex→studio→bri→admin→pasted URL states.
